tooltip.text: One row per Ignition Gateway detailing Area, Name, Type, Description, Version, License Keys, and Redundancy / Development

onChange.script:
if currentValue.value and not previousValue.value and not (self.getSibling("Config").props.selected or self.getSibling("Load").props.selected or self.getSibling("Resources").props.selected):
		self.getSibling("Config").props.selected = True
		self.getSibling("Load").props.selected = True
		self.getSibling("Resources").props.selected = True

if not currentValue.value and not self.getSibling("Load").props.selected and not self.getSibling("Resources").props.selected:
		self.getSibling("Gateways").props.selected = False

if not currentValue.value and not self.getSibling("Config").props.selected and not self.getSibling("Resources").props.selected:
		self.getSibling("Gateways").props.selected = False

if not currentValue.value and not self.getSibling("Config").props.selected and not self.getSibling("Load").props.selected:
		self.getSibling("Gateways").props.selected = False

config.script:
if self.session.custom.audit.global:
		# Log Exports closed
		system.util.audit(action="Closed", actionTarget="Exports")
	system.perspective.closePopup("Export")
